11084|87a66ee0.name: Tarn
11084|87a66ee0.text: I cannot help you with further training: your skill at working with leather rivals my own. You should speak with Una, over there. I will vouch for your skill if need be.

11901|c5ceacbe.name: Andruk
11901|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

12736|e3f9a765.name: Je'neu Sancrea
12736|e3f9a765.text: The elements speak to us, $c.  They share knowledge that we must learn, and they share secrets that must be kept.

15350|44b49612.name: Horde Warbringer
15350|44b49612.text: War is upon us, $N.  It's time for every member of the Horde to answer the call and join the fight against the cowardly Alliance.

2995|bfaf54b7.name: Tal
2995|bfaf54b7.text: When mounted on the back of a wind rider, one sees that its reputation for strength and speed is well earned.

3007|501c3600.name: Una
3007|501c3600.text: Cairne has brought us to a land rich with possibilities for the future. We have been fortunate, and so in turn we pass on our good fortune to others. That is why I began teaching, $N.

3008|d055944a.name: Mak
3008|d055944a.text: Your talent is beyond my own, friend. Speak with Tarn here; his knowledge of leather is much greater than mine. I'm sure he would welcome another student.

3031|1605f087.name: Tigor Skychaser
3031|1605f087.text: The spirits have guided you to me. How may I be of service?

3084|538d6d78.name: Bluffwatcher
3084|538d6d78.text: The Hall of Spirits is where our shamans call home.  You can find it on the Spirit Rise.  May your ancestors watch over you.

3309|2f8d506f.name: Karus
3309|2f8d506f.text: Besides the Grunts outside, my brothers and I fought at the battle of Hyjal. Any who seek to steal from the bank must face us first.

3309|6b36598f.name: Karus
3309|6b36598f.text: I guarantee this bank's security with my own blood, is that good enough for you?

3310|cc0cf280.name: Doras
3310|cc0cf280.text: You haven't lived until you've looked down on the world from the back of a wind rider.

3389|5612724d.name: Regthar Deathgate
3389|5612724d.text: We have our duties, $c.  Duties to the Horde.

3412|d0fc10c2.name: Nogg
3412|d0fc10c2.text: If there were just a few more hours in a day...

4877|fe134d60.name: Jandia
4877|fe134d60.text: Hail, friend. Can I interest you in any of my trade supplies?

6929|7161de72.name: Innkeeper Gryshka
6929|7161de72.text: If we are to make these new lands ours then we must have places to rest our battle weary bodies. Lay your axe by the fire and share the stories of your mighty battles.

9087|e4fd33dd.name: Bashana Runetotem
9087|e4fd33dd.text: Greetings, noble $c.  This humble servant of the Cenarion Circle wishes blessings and bounties be given unto you and yours.

1145-accept.name: Korran
1145-accept.text:
Many travelers who've come through the Crossroads helped me gather eggs from the Field of Giants, and many of them have tales of how deadly the creatures are. I've heard enough to consider them insects a much larger threat than my masters first thought.

I need a courier to travel to Orgrimmar to meet Belgrom Rockmaul. It be no simple matter, and someone who would take the task seriously should go.

Belgrom usually be found outside the warriors' guild house.
1145-accept.title: The Swarm Grows

1149-accept.name: Dorn Plainstalker
1149-accept.text:
So, you have sought me out, or perhaps destiny brings you to me? No matter. You are here now, and so your journey will begin anew.

Many facets make up a being: the spirit, the body, the mind. Some of these can be measured by a culture's traditions. Others we can only hope exist within ourselves. If you agree, I shall test some of the facets within you.

If you pass, then you shall become stronger. If you fail, then you will realize the vastness of the Nether.

The first is a Test of Faith.
1149-accept.title: Test of Faith

1149-complete.name: Dorn Plainstalker
1149-complete.text:
It is not until faced with unforeseen adversity that we begin to see how strong our spirits are. You took the leap of faith even though you had no guarantees that you would survive. Your mind is open, and your spirit is prepared for what is to come.

If you are willing, then the next of your tests is ready.
1149-complete.title: Test of Faith

1150-accept.name: Dorn Plainstalker
1150-accept.text:
I'm pleased to see your courage remains steadfast in light of what you've already done. Since your faith is intact, the time has come to test your body.

First is a test of endurance. Go with friends to the Roguefeather Den west of Freewind Post. Make your way to the depths of their lair and destroy their foodstuffs. By then you should have provoked their fury, and if you are able to survive long enough, Grenka Bloodscreech herself will come for you--kill her and bring me her claw to complete your test.
1150-accept.title: Test of Endurance

1150-complete.name: Dorn Plainstalker
1150-complete.text:
Grenka was powerful, even by $r standards. You should be proud of your accomplishment this day.

During your test of faith you displayed strength of spirit, and now you have shown endurance in battle by taking on the Roguefeather harpies, but the time has come for a new test.
1150-complete.title: Test of Endurance

1150-progress.name: Dorn Plainstalker
1150-progress.text:
You must be prepared spiritually, physically and mentally for the challenges that lie ahead of you.

Too often do we rush forward before we are ready. I consider it my duty to the youth, no matter which tribe they belong to, to prepare them for the dangers they may face after they leave the sanctity of their home.
1150-progress.title: Test of Endurance

1151-accept.name: Dorn Plainstalker
1151-accept.text:
During the time of the Old Gods, elementals inhabited much of this world. They worshipped the Old Gods, and the Gods, through their power, kept the elementals bound to this world. When the Old Gods were banished, the elementals faded from our world and now only return at the bidding of powerful mages.

There are exceptions though. Some elementals were powerful enough to remain here on their own. One such elemental is Rok'Alim.

To test your strength, find Rok'Alim in Thousand Needles and slay him.
1151-accept.title: Test of Strength

1151-complete.name: Dorn Plainstalker
1151-complete.text: The Test of Strength is done. You have shown strength and bravery, and you are now prepared for the final test before these rites are completed.
1151-complete.title: Test of Strength

1151-progress.name: Dorn Plainstalker
1151-progress.text: Rok'Alim is also called the Pounder by the centaur tribes in Thousand Needles because of the thundering his fists make as he pummels the creatures brave, or stupid, enough to stand in his path.
1151-progress.title: Test of Strength

1152-accept.name: Dorn Plainstalker
1152-accept.text:
Your time with me is just about finished. I am knowledgeable, but the Test of Lore is not mine to give. There are lessons to be learned and places to visit that others claim domain over.

If you are prepared, then seek out Braug Dimspirit--he is a $c of great wisdom. He will test you further, so heed his words, $N.

When you are ready, find the tunnel that connects the Stonetalon Mountains with Ashenvale: Braug dwells near there. And be careful, $N, the night elves may wish to impede your test.
1152-accept.title: Test of Lore

1361-accept.name: Belgrom Rockmaul
1361-accept.text:
A warrior of the Horde, Regthar Deathgate, is recruiting agents for a mission into the land of Desolace.  Speak with him if you wish to volunteer.  He is stationed in the Barrens, in a series of bunkers west of the Crossroads.

And sharpen your weapons.  Desolace is a place torn by war.
1361-accept.title: Regthar Deathgate

1361-complete.name: Regthar Deathgate
1361-complete.text: Yes, I am recruiting.  This mission leads into Desolace, against the centaur there.  I will be brief so that you may quickly begin.
1361-complete.title: Regthar Deathgate

1362-accept.name: Regthar Deathgate
1362-accept.text:
The Kolkar centaur live in Desolace, and their forces have spread into the Barrens.  This is a known fact and we have Horde agents dealing with them here.

But as long as the centaur are strong in Desolace, they will always pose a threat.  It is time we rid ourselves of that threat.

Speak with Felgur Twocuts at Ghost Walker Post in Desolace.  He was sent to gather intelligence on the centaur.  He will know how to best deal with the Kolkar of Desolace.
1362-accept.title: The Kolkar of Desolace

1532-accept.name: Xanis Flameweaver
1532-accept.text:
The winds of Kalimdor rush to meet you and you shall be counted among some of our most powerful sisters. I am proud to see you have come this far and have such a promising future.

The element of air is a difficult one to control, but I have faith that your skills will overcome any obstacles that are placed in front of you.

Head to the very south of the Barrens, and enter Thousand Needles. It is there, far to the east, that you will find Prate Cloudseer. She will teach you more.
1532-accept.title: Call of Air

1532-complete.name: Prate Cloudseer
1532-complete.text: For the time being, I shall give you what you need to focus your spells and to call upon the spirits of air. Take this totem, and when you are ready, train with me some more.
1532-complete.title: Call of Air

2841-accept.name: Nogg
2841-accept.text:
Gnome technology - two years ago its most common use was as a punch line. Times certainly have changed. Now they've got a new rig built that's better than all our shredder models combined. I need the blueprints, $N!

Unfortunately, the plans are locked away in a safe near Mekgineer Thermaplugg. To make matters worse, the combination to the safe is only known by Mekgineer Thermaplugg.

Do whatever you have to do to get that combination, $N. Then crack open that safe and bring back those blueprints!
2841-accept.title: Rig Wars

2951-accept.name: Unknown
2951-accept.text:
This contraption stands out amongst the gnomes holding out against the madness outside the room.  A small plaque on the device reads "The Sparklematic 5200", followed by some text:

"Grime and residue ruining your sparklies?  The Sparklematic 5200 puts the shine back in shine-tastic!  Insert the item you wish to clean and deposit three silver coins in the coin slot.  Give the Sparklematic 5200 a moment for operation, and voila!  Your valuables will emerge clean and shiny!"
2951-accept.title: The Sparklematic 5200!

2951-complete.name: Unknown
2951-complete.text: You insert the grime-encrusted item and three silver coins into the Sparklematic 5200.  The machine surges to life in an almost frenzied attempt to purge the grime from the unknown item.  Loud, violent churning sounds beat from the heart of the machine.  The metal frame of the beast creaks and groans as it lurches from side to side...
2951-complete.title: The Sparklematic 5200!

2951-progress.name: Unknown
2951-progress.text: It would seem that the device needs some sort of grime-encrusted object to clean and three silver coins to get the contraption working.  So long as both are present, the Sparklematic 5200 should work...
2951-progress.title: The Sparklematic 5200!

2952-complete.name: Unknown
2952-complete.text:
As quickly as it started, the Sparklematic 5200 comes to an abrupt halt.  A simple "ding" is heard from the machine, and the mouth of the machine spirals upward.  Inside the Sparklematic 5200 is a small box wrapped in a little bow.  The machine would appear to wrap an object up after eliminating its grime-encrusted status.  Even if the machine didn't work, at least the item is now wrapped in a pretty box.

Well, there is one way to find out if it cleaned the item or not...
2952-complete.title: The Sparklematic 5200!

2953-complete.name: Unknown
2953-complete.text:
The Sparklematic 5200 comes to life, lurching to and fro.  Inside, the helpless grime that has encrusted the object placed within it is being pulverized by the machine's gnomish cleaning agent.

The Sparklematic 5200 comes to a halt, heralded by a familiar "ding!"  The item receptacle of the machine spirals open, revealing a neatly wrapped box.
2953-complete.title: More Sparklematic Action

2953-progress.name: Unknown
2953-progress.text: The Sparklematic 5200 is empty, awaiting a grime-encrusted object to clean and three silver coins to start!
2953-progress.title: More Sparklematic Action

4767-complete.name: Elu
4767-complete.text: Perfect! With these eggs I hope to take the next step to become a wind rider. Here is a token of my appreciation; may good hunting always shine upon you, $C.
4767-complete.title: Wind Rider

4767-progress.name: Elu
4767-progress.text: $N, have you retrieved the wyvern eggs that I seek? I'm really anxious to start my wind rider training!
4767-progress.title: Wind Rider

4881-accept.name: Unknown
4881-accept.text: The Tauren, Kanati Greycloud is bold to set up a hunting camp in Thousand Needles. We must kill him to rid this hunting camp and all who may follow him. We will converge at the small post Southwest of the Great Lift.
4881-accept.title: Assassination Plot

4881-complete.name: Kanati Greycloud
4881-complete.text: They come to kill me?  I will show them how a Tauren fights!
4881-complete.title: Assassination Plot

4966-accept.name: Kanati Greycloud
4966-accept.text: But, there may be more centaur than I thought, I ask you, $N, to fight with me against these vile assassins.
4966-accept.title: Protect Kanati Greycloud

4966-complete.name: Kanati Greycloud
4966-complete.text: Thank you for your help, $N. I couldn't have held them off without you.
4966-complete.title: Protect Kanati Greycloud

5088-complete.name: Motega Firemane
5088-complete.text:
This does not make sense. Why would Arikara be after Cairne Bloodhoof? Magatha could not be wrong, she is our most powerful $c.

<Motega shakes his head.>

Regardless, your great deed to the Horde shall not go unnoticed - please, choose one of these as a reward for your aid.
5088-complete.title: Arikara

5088-progress.name: Motega Firemane
5088-progress.text: Have you slain the vicious serpent Arikara, $N?
5088-progress.title: Arikara

5151-complete.name: Wizlo Bearingshiner
5151-complete.text: My hypercapacitor! This will keep me busy for a while until I can figure out what it does...
5151-complete.title: Hypercapacitor Gizmo

6561-complete.name: Bashana Runetotem
6561-complete.text:
Kelris has eluded the Argent Dawn for some time.

For some time they considered him dead or missing.

By ending his reign you have spared the lives of many innocent people, $N.

Earthmother be praised! To sacrifice another to a servant of an Old God for personal gain is beyond disgusting!

You have done a great thing this day. Kelris was a creature of evil and sought to bring the world back to a time of chaos by worshipping such creatures as the Old Gods. Thank you, $N.
6561-complete.title: Blackfathom Villainy

6561-progress.name: Bashana Runetotem
6561-progress.text:
May the Earthmother be with you, $N.

Peace between the earth and all her people should be our goal. She has a grand plan for nature, and we all have a role to play in that plan.
6561-progress.title: Blackfathom Villainy

6565-complete.name: Je'neu Sancrea
6565-complete.text:
Very good!! Thank you, $N. We may not have stopped the Twilight's Hammer completely, but at least you have staved off another of their plans to return the Old Gods to power.

Who knows what other plans they have manifesting, but we can rest easy for now.
6565-complete.title: Allegiance to the Old Gods

79360-accept.name: Prate Cloudseer
79360-accept.text:
Now that you have mastered the elements, you have an obligation to them, and thus to all of Azeroth herself. We call to them for aid, we do not demand their power. It is time you return the favors granted to you. And I think I know how.

The quilboar twist the elements for their own ends, and seem to be extending their reach within these borders. Go into their kraul and put an end to whatever they scheme. These lands must be protected.
79360-accept.title: Elemental Aid

98069-complete.name: Jandia
98069-complete.text: Thank you, $N. These supplies will help get us through until the next shipment arrives.
98069-complete.title: Stolen Freewind Supplies

98069-progress.name: Jandia
98069-progress.text: Have you been able to recover the supplies the harpies stole?
98069-progress.title: Stolen Freewind Supplies

98070-complete.name: Jandia
98070-complete.text: This is wonderful news! I will send word to our suppliers that the harpies have been dealt with. At least that is one less threat the future caravans will need to worry about.
98070-complete.title: Stop the Screeching

98887-accept.name: Horde Warbringer
98887-accept.text:
The Theramore Expeditionary Force are tenacious and continue to send reinforcements to bolster their position on the Darkspear Islands. 

Go, show them the might of the Horde! Bring me the evidence of your victory in this key battleground and you will be well rewarded.
98887-accept.title: Conflict at Darkspear Islands
